verdict.rationale: Missive's docs describe general team-collaboration capabilities — composing emails together, team chat, assigning conversations while 'maintaining visibility', and 'collaborate behind the scenes — without changing your workflow' — which are consistent with an internal-discussion feature, but no evidence explicitly describes a side-thread comment/@mention UI attached to a specific email message. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of in-conversation comment threads, @mention notifications, and confirmation these replace forwarding workflows.
